content.text:
**One traversal.**

All four objectives (ux, bugs, onboarding and content) are Mode A Journey lenses. The plugin's mode table (`commands/run.md:131`) maps Mode A to `traversal-journey`, with "one traversal per persona". The skill works on "capture once, score many times" (`skills/traversal-journey/SKILL.md:10`): a single signed-in journey writes the screenshots, session log, timeline and debrief, and each of the four lenses scores that same capture afterwards.

So it's 1 mode × 1 persona = 1 traversal. The four lenses add scoring passes, not browser runs. The number would only go up if you added a persona or an objective from another mode, such as clarity (website visit), seo (crawl) or technical (measurement).
